metadata.title: Violence Semantic Patterns
metadata.description: Semantic patterns for the violence universe.

concepts.title: Violence Event
concepts.description: A violent act, harm event, or physical escalation.

concepts.title: Violence Threat
concepts.description: A threat, warning, or intimidation that signals harm.

concepts.title: Violence Attempt
concepts.description: An attempt to commit violence that may or may not succeed.

concepts.title: Violence Glorification
concepts.description: Praise, celebration, or normalization of violence.

concepts.title: Violence Encouragement
concepts.description: Encouraging someone else to use violence.

concepts.title: Violence Instruction
concepts.description: Operational guidance for violent action.

concepts.title: Violence Reward
concepts.description: Violence framed as rewarded, desirable, or beneficial.

concepts.title: Violence Revenge
concepts.description: Violence framed as retaliation or payback.

concepts.title: Violence Self Defense
concepts.description: Violence framed as self-defense or protection.

concepts.title: Violence Law Enforcement
concepts.description: Violence framed as police, security, or lawful force.

concepts.title: Violence Accident
concepts.description: Violence that happens by accident or unintended impact.

concepts.title: Violence Negligence
concepts.description: Violence caused by negligence, omission, or carelessness.

concepts.title: Violence Condemnation
concepts.description: Violence mentioned to reject, criticize, or condemn it.

concepts.title: Violence Documentary
concepts.description: Violence discussed in documentary or factual reporting context.

concepts.title: Violence Historical
concepts.description: Violence framed as a historical event or record.

concepts.title: Violence Training
concepts.description: Violence used in training, safety, or educational practice.

concepts.title: Violence Game
concepts.description: Violence embedded in a game, simulation, or play context.

concepts.title: Violence Fantasy
concepts.description: Violence in fantasy, mythic, or imaginary settings.

concepts.title: Violence Comedy
concepts.description: Violence played for humor, irony, or comedic effect.

concepts.title: Violence Dream
concepts.description: Violence appearing in a dream or dreamlike scene.

concepts.title: Violence Flashback
concepts.description: Violence shown as a flashback or recollection.

concepts.title: Violence Memory
concepts.description: Violence recalled from memory or remembered experience.

concepts.title: Violence Imagination
concepts.description: Violence imagined, hypothesized, or mentally simulated.

concepts.title: Violence Failed Attempt
concepts.description: A violent act that fails or is interrupted.

concepts.title: Violence Offscreen
concepts.description: Violence implied to occur outside the visible frame.

concepts.title: Violence Scene Description
concepts.description: Violence conveyed through descriptive scene language.

concepts.title: Violence Dialogue
concepts.description: Violence delivered in dialogue or quoted speech.

concepts.title: Violence Reported by Character
concepts.description: Violence described by one character about another event.

concepts.title: Violence Observed
concepts.description: Violence directly witnessed or observed by a character or narrator.

concepts.title: Violence Implied
concepts.description: Violence suggested by context rather than explicit wording.

concepts.title: Violence Against Child
concepts.description: Violence targeting a child or minor.

concepts.title: Violence Against Woman
concepts.description: Violence targeting a woman or female-presenting target.

concepts.title: Violence Against Disabled
concepts.description: Violence targeting a disabled person.

concepts.title: Violence Against Public
concepts.description: Violence targeting the public, crowd, or civilians.

concepts.title: Violence Against State
concepts.description: Violence targeting state institutions or authority.
